primary_hypothesis: Net Mean R for entries with benchmark above EMA200 exceeds entries below EMA200.
primary_inference: Entry-month cluster bootstrap, fixed seed 20261002, 2000 draws, 95% interval; descriptive and inconclusive if either group has fewer than 20 trades or fewer than 6 observed months.
secondary_observational_hypotheses: 63-session relative-strength deciles, ranked before setup selection among the available liquid universe
252-session relative-strength deciles and distance above EMA200 bins 0-10%, 10-20%, 20-40%, 40%+
Leave-one-out sector-peer 63-session RS positive versus nonpositive; at least two peers
ATR20 percentile quintiles, ATR20 divided by prior-20-session mean, and expanding Bollinger bandwidth
Known upcoming earnings within five exchange sessions, only with historically observed event times and auditable coverage
controls: No new live entry filters or parameter winner selected from retrospective tables
No favorable-excursion inference from unknown same-day stop/target ordering
No overlapping secondary tests presented as confirmed alpha
Preserve first-observed features and strategy version in append-only paper signals
No historical or backdated fills counted as prospective observations
Record unfilled, no-trade and operational-failure days; do not remove unfavorable outcomes
Keep every prespecified policy and subgroup in the report; missing groups mean missing evidence
No performance-dependent stopping or automatic deployment; changes require a new protocol version
required_data: full point-in-time membership baseline and dated additions/removals
as-of earnings schedules with coverage provenance
